Title: GeoMasterApiSubscriptionImpactNonGets
Description:
The number of impacted subscriptions exceeded the threshold in the last 30 mins. This will create an auto-post. The thresholds are different. ARM data is used for comms and only subs with 5 or more request with status 429 or 5xx are notified. You can get this list by executing the function GeoSubImpact in our central or west us Kusto clusters. The call looks like the below, just update the datetime to the incident start time. This alert should correlate to the AllRequests alert and only post once.

Execute: [Web] [Web (Lens)] [Desktop] [Desktop (SAW)] https://wawscus.kusto.windows.net:443/wawsprodGeoSubImpact(datetime(2018-11-07 20:00:00), now())

GeoMaster dashboard link: https://jarvis-west.dc.ad.msft.net/dashboard/WAWS/Deployments/[cloud]%2520Geomaster%2520Check

Regional Geomaster dashboard link: https://jarvis-west.dc.ad.msft.net/dashboard/WAWS/Deployments/Regional%2520GeoMaster%2520check

Mitigation: TSG: GeomasterApiSubscriptionImpactAllRequests  (Web view)


If this does not help then involve the Control Plane team - Antares Management Loop Team in ICM.

PrimaryKustoQuery.Title: Primary kusto query
PrimaryKustoQuery.KustoQuery:
let throttledApi = (AntaresAdminGeoEvents
    | where PreciseTimeStamp > ago(30m)
    | where EventId == 50109
    | where column_ifexists('BlockRequest', false) == true
    | project ActivityId);
AntaresAdminGeoEvents 
| where TIMESTAMP > ago(30m)
| where EventId == 40006 and Verb != "GET" 
| where ActivityId !in (throttledApi)
| where IsGeomasterByEventStampName(EventStampName)
| where not(WebSpaceName startswith "arm-runner" and StatusCode == 429 and Verb == 'DELETE')
| where not(WebSpaceName startswith "auroralite-arm-runner" and StatusCode == 429 and Verb == 'DELETE')
| project Verb, StatusCode, ApiType, EventId, SubscriptionId , EventStampName, AddressTemplate, SourceNamespace, TargetHostName
| summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500 or (StatusCode == 429 and AddressTemplate != 'subscriptions/{subscriptionId}')) by SubscriptionId, EventStampName, SourceNamespace, TargetHostName
| extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs)
| summarize totalSubs = count(), affectedSubs = countif(availability< 100) by EventStampName, SourceNamespace, TargetHostName
| where totalSubs > 10 and affectedSubs > 5
| extend impact = affectedSubs*100.0/ totalSubs
| extend impactThreshold = GetSubImpactThresholdByEventStampNameAndTotalSubs(EventStampName, totalSubs, 10, 50, 50)
| where impact > impactThreshold
| extend TargetLocation = substring(TargetHostName, 0, indexof(TargetHostName, "."))
| extend CorrelationId = iff(IsRegionalGeomasterByEventStampName(EventStampName) and TargetLocation != replace_string(EventStampName, "rgm-prod-", "")
    , strcat("rgm-prod-", TargetLocation), EventStampName)
| extend MonitorId = strcat(SourceNamespace, iif(EventStampName contains "int", "Not", ""), "ApiAutoPost")
    , CorrelationId
    , titlePrefix = iif(SourceNamespace == "WAWS" and EventStampName !contains "int", "[AppServiceCP][AutoComms],", "[AppServiceCP],")
| project-away SourceNamespace

SecondaryKustoQueries.Title: NonGet Availability
SecondaryKustoQueries.KustoQuery: AntaresAdminGeoEvents | where EventStampName  == "{correlationId}" and TIMESTAMP > ago(6h) and EventId == 40006 | extend Ok=iif(StatusCode<500 and Verb !="GET" and StatusCode != 429,100.0,0.0) | summarize avg(Ok) by bin(TIMESTAMP, 1m)

SecondaryKustoQueries.Title: Subscription Impact
SecondaryKustoQueries.KustoQuery: AntaresAdminGeoEvents | where TIMESTAMP > ago(30m) and EventStampName  == "{correlationId}" | where EventId == 40006 and Verb != "Get" | project Verb, StatusCode, ApiType, EventId, SubscriptionId , EventStampName | summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500 or StatusCode == 429) by SubscriptionId , EventStampName | extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs) | summarize totalSubs = count(), affectedSubs = countif(availability< 100) by EventStampName | extend impact = affectedSubs*100.0/ totalSubs

SecondaryKustoQueries.Title: GeoMaster Exceptions
SecondaryKustoQueries.KustoQuery: AntaresAdminGeoEvents | where TIMESTAMP > ago(6h) and EventStampName  == "{correlationId}" and Level == 2 | project TIMESTAMP , EventMessage, Exception, EventStampName | summarize ExceptionCount = count(), SqlExceptionCount = countif(Exception contains "SqlException") by bin(TIMESTAMP, 1m), EventStampName

SecondaryKustoQueries.Title: GeoMaster CPU
